author: Samsung
description:
This is the official video introducing AI Motion Wind of the Bespoke AI WindFree Pro, Samsung's new room air conditioner.

Experience a variety of seven tailored wind modes, ranging from Max Wind to WindFree™.

-Max Wind: opens outer wings fully to provide instant cooling
-Surround Wind: creates a natural breeze that evenly reaches every corner
-Long Reach Wind: sends cool air twice as far across the room
-Down Wind: rapidly pushes hot air downward for quick comfort
-AI Direct Wind: follows you with targeted cooling
-AI Indirect Wind: ensures the targeted user stays comfortable without direct breeze
-WindFree™: gives gentle coolness

Also, Radar Sensors track your movement to deliver precisely the coolness you need.

Q: So, how does a Radar Sensor work?
A: It tracks movement to automatically select the most efficient cooling mode. Wind direction and intensity are adjusted based on user data — number of occupants, activity level and their locations. 

#AIMotionWind #TailoredWind #Radar
